status: four confirmed defects; source implementation has not begun

findings.title: Preserve the approved bugfix contract at completion
findings.failure: begin authorizes a schema edit with its approved contract; done rechecks eligibility without contract_id and rejects the valid task.
findings.correction: Carry contract_id through completion and retain approved-status, identity and scope validation.

findings.title: Content-bind inherited dirty work
findings.failure: Matching porcelain status/path tuples exempt inherited paths even when their bytes, index objects, mode or link target change.
findings.correction: Immutable versioned index and no-follow worktree observations; compare every inherited rename/copy endpoint including paths absent from current status; refuse legacy exemptions that lack historical proof.

findings.title: Validate QA capture contents and exact candidate identity
findings.failure: Passing declared check references ordinary failed capture metadata; direct completion accepts it. A 64-character candidate_sha256 is not checked by its 40-character HEAD comparison.
findings.correction: Bind each structured capture to assessed candidate, command, actual result and stream hashes; distinguish source commit from candidate manifest identity.
findings.delivery_scope: separate proof-validation change; outside F1/F2 contract
findings.limits: Synthetic contradictory capture fixture in disposable Git repo. Explicit failed declared checks and stale 40-character candidates are already rejected.

findings.title: Use the same QA proof rule for receipt prerequisites
findings.failure: Receipt fresh-qa aggregate counters can pass with absent per-check evidence or an explicit failed check; verifier accepts and transition planner proposes advance while direct qa_passes rejects.
findings.correction: Shared structured QA validation for direct completion and receipt prerequisites, retaining existing receipt command proof checks.
findings.delivery_scope: separate proof-validation change; outside F1/F2 contract
findings.limits: Synthetic QA/authority in disposable upstream ReceiptFixture, actual successful receipt command. No real transition applied. Receipt own captures already validate execution, result, argv, candidate and stream references.

additional_design_concern.description: verify_route_scope_eligibility accepts a candidate parameter without inspecting it. Candidate-to-scope linkage needs explicit treatment in proof-validation design.
additional_design_concern.evidence_status: source-confirmed; no separate end-to-end exploit claim

proof_semantics_to_preserve: An expected-negative test needs an explicit expected-result predicate; an ordinary failed capture does not qualify as a pass.
Empty stdout or stderr is valid when its exact byte identity and the test predicate are satisfied.
A hash establishes artifact identity; interpreting and validating its contents is still required.
implementation_gate: Both pre-code reviews approve the F1/F2 contract; the approved-contract record and actual successful high-risk preflight in a usable implementation environment remain necessary.
excluded_other_repository_fix: CL-040 empty Git blob handling belongs to nizamiq/cl-nizamiq; it is not a nizam-framework defect.
